Subject: SOC 2 post-report affirmation needed for procurement (gap: 2026-12-31 -> present)

Hi David,

Thanks again for the SOC 2 Type II report you sent last week. Our procurement team has a compliance checkpoint for our vendor onboarding: they want a short signed assertion that covers the period after the report end date (report covers through 2026-12-31) up to the current date — essentially a continuity attestation that critical controls remained in place.

TrustAudit is doing a quick verification; they asked for either a bridge-style attestation or a one-page addendum that confirms nothing material changed in scope or control design since the report end date. The procurement deadline is tight (we need signed docs by Mar 15).

Can Redwood provide a short addendum/attestation and a one-page evidence checklist we can share with TrustAudit? If you have a template, that would be ideal. We can accept an electronically signed DocuSign.

Attached: HelixMed_internal_risk_notes.pdf (for context)

Appreciate the quick help — happy to jump on a 15-min call if that helps.

Best,

Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 post-report affirmation needed for procurement (gap: 2026-12-31 -> present)

Thanks — reviewed HelixMed's note and the attached draft. Key items I propose:

1) Attestation language (concise):
Redwood Inference affirms that, to the best of our knowledge and subject to the scope of the SOC 2 Type II report dated 2026-12-31, there have been no material changes to the control environment, system scope, or control design relevant to the report as of the attestation date.

2) Evidence checklist (one page):
- KMS/HSM: current KMS provider and key rotation cadence (attach KMS summary)
- Logging & retention: confirmation of centralized audit log retention, retention period (90 days), and availability for review
- Incidents: high-level summary of any incidents since 2027-01-01 (none impacting scope)
- Change control: confirmation that change control policy applied to production changes in scope

3) Signer authority: must be an officer with oversight of security/compliance (I can sign as Head of Compliance).

4) Minor edits: tighten the period language (end date + attestation date) and add a sentence: "This attestation is not a substitute for a full reassessment or audit."

Attaching the edited draft and a checklist stub: HelixMed_SOC2_gap_checklist.pdf (see attachments). Marissa — once we finalize language I'll mark for signature and loop in David to review final copy.

Irene Choi
Director, Compliance & Controls, Redwood Inference
